title: Globalisation

blocks.heading: Globalisation
blocks.text: Globalisation is increasing international connectedness and interdependence through flows such as trade, investment, information and people. It differs from global warming, a rise in global average temperature. Communication can support globalisation but does not by itself establish fair access.
context_tags: original teaching; fictional examples where stated

blocks.heading: Use the evidence
blocks.text: Explain whether this fictional change is globalisation or global warming: a local processor begins coordinating orders and suppliers across three countries; no temperature evidence is supplied. It illustrates globalisation because production and exchange are becoming more internationally connected. It supplies no evidence of a change in global average temperature, so the shared word global does not make it global warming.
context_tags: original teaching; fictional examples where stated
